title: Help on the Train
topic: เรื่องจริงน่าประทับใจ
lines: Small acts of kindness happen every day, and sometimes they change lives.
Last March, Lena Park was traveling by train from Seoul to Busan. About
an hour into the trip, she started to feel dizzy, and her hands began to
shake. She had skipped lunch because she was late for the train, and she
has diabetes. **She** knew her blood sugar was dangerously low.
Luckily, the man sitting across from her noticed. **He** was a retired
nurse named Mr. Cho. He asked her a few quick questions, then gave her
the orange juice and crackers from **his** own bag. He stayed with her and
checked her pulse every few minutes until she felt better. Lena was awake
the whole time and could talk, but she was too weak to stand.
When the train arrived, Mr. Cho walked with her to the station café to
make sure she ate a proper meal. Lena later wrote about him online, and
thousands of people shared **her** story. Stories like **this** remind us that
the person next to us might be the one who helps us on our worst day.
